items.title: Norman Mason Interview, 1960-02-06
items.q: Johnny Sincere who played the guitar

ctx.x: is Norman Kellogg Mason and my name is Paul Crawford and this is being recorded in the Sheraton Jefferson Hotel room 1153 in st. Louis Missouri and the date is February 6 1960 I believe that's right isn't it now mr. Mason would you tell us where you were born and when and what your parents

I was born in Nassau in the Bahama Islands November 25th in 1895 and my father's name was Ellis Mason Ellis and Alice yes and I came to the States in 1913 it was I first thought it was first said that I was born in Miami and went in Nassau but after a little more deliberation I find out that instead of it being that way I was really born in in Nassau started my father started me out playing the trumpet with intention of playing in the church which we were all members of the Episcopal Church but after a short time…

items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: I'm not sure, I believe he got a few lessons from Norman Mason.

ctx.x: He learned how to play sax right on the board. I'm not sure, I believe he got a few lessons from Norman Mason. And he just went right on from there and became one of our best saxophone players.
I know Armstrong gives him credit for helping him with his music too.
